item.title: Chiefs push for ban on Tabua sales
item.description: The Great Council of Chiefs wants the domestic sale of tabua banned completely. Council Chairman Ratu Viliame Seruvakula said the sacred whale’s tooth is being commercialised in pawn shops at inflated prices. He added that tabua is not a commodity but central to iTaukei tradition and identity. The Council has agreed to pass a resolution […]

item.title: Petrol prices drop but LPG jumps
item.description: Fuel prices will drop while LPG prices will increase from tomorrow. The Fijian Competition and Consumer Commission has set the new regulated rates for March 2026.
